reddit.title: Improving Audio Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the audio experience in Provincia! The music now transitions smoothly between day, night, title, and combat beds without any abrupt cuts. This enhancement ensures a more immersive gameplay experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
